items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Everybody the band just read except Petty Babu and Joe, Joe Renner the drummer, he couldn't read.

ctx.x: Was it from Jasper? Yeah, that's Blunt. And was he a reader or a faker or both?
Was he a reader or a faker or both? Who uh... Jasper. Blunt. Yeah, he did it. Yeah, I know. Everybody the band just read except Petty Babu and Joe, Joe Renner the drummer, he couldn't read.
Did they read much or was it mostly by ear?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And I said, how do you, Joe Renner? Joe said 45.

ctx.x: What band was that? Let me see my band. Oh, that was a little bit of a band. Bobby used to play. And we had facial for it. And with facial and that, we got Bobby. And when Bobby left, we got Black Benny. And that's where Black Benny said he was going to make a man out of himself. And Black Benny stuck with it, so they got killed. And a little while after that, that's where the band broke up. Maurice come in, you know, from the war. Chris Johnson had taken all the Cornette players. We had to keep on changing…
Ask me about bazooka players. Bazooka? Yeah, you know, like those big horns made out of two pieces of pipe.
